Computers

计算机 · 141 词 · 2 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1The goal of early calculating machines was to simplify difficult sums. As technology advanced, early vacuum tubes gave way to electronic chips, and a revolution in artificial intelligence began. From then on, computers changed our lives completely. They can not only download information from the web over a network or via a mobile phone signal, but also solve different types of logical problems. Under the guidance of human operators, they can even control rockets to explore the moon and instruct humanlike androids to mop floors and watch over your naughty niece. Anyhow, computers are so helpful that they do bring happiness.

2However, computers are easily attacked by viruses. This has become a difficult problem to deal with. The reality is that computers can be dangerous in certain situations. Personally, I worry about their widespread use in some fields, such as finance.

高考英语3500词 · 08中文译文

计算机

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1早期计算机器的用途是简化复杂的算术。后来，新技术让电子芯片取代了电子管，人工智能也迎来了一场变革。从那以后，计算机彻底改变了我们的生活。连上网络或接收到手机信号时，计算机可以从网上下载信息，还能解决各种逻辑问题。在操作人员的指导下，它甚至能控制火箭探测月球，也能指挥具有人类特征的机器人拖地，帮你照看淘气的侄女。总之，计算机很有用，的确给人带来了不少快乐。

2不过，计算机很容易受到病毒攻击，这已经成了一个棘手的问题。因此，计算机在某些情况下也会带来危险。我就对它在金融等领域的普遍使用有些担心。
